children: Alight reported third-quarter 2026 revenue of $500 million, down 6.2% from $533 million a year earlier, as lower net commercial activity weighed on results. The company recorded a $51 million net loss attributable to Alight, compared with a $1.067 billion loss in the prior-year quarter, which included a $1.338 billion goodwill impairment. Diluted loss per share was $1.93, versus $40.52 a year earlier.
Revenue was $500M, compared with $533M in the prior-year quarter; year-over-year change was (6.2%).
Net loss attributable to Alight was $51M, compared with a $1.067B net loss in the prior-year quarter.
Diluted loss per share was $1.93, compared with $40.52 in the prior-year quarter.
Nine-month revenue declined 4.0% to $1.545B, while recurring revenue fell 6.3% in the quarter and 4.9% over the first nine months, primarily due to weaker net commercial activity.
Prior-year client losses and lower bookings continue to weigh on growth, with management expecting effects through the rest of 2026 and into 2027.
Lower revenue and higher compensation costs reduced gross profit; productivity initiatives provided partial cost savings.
Alight acquired Abett Inc. on October 1 to strengthen benefits intelligence capabilities within Health Solutions.
